footer.tagline: Personalised photo products with live preview.
footer.note: Printed on demand · Premium quality · Delivered to your door

cart.title: Your cart
cart.saved_body: We have your uploaded image and will print from the mockup you created. Checkout may still show the stock product photo — that does not affect your print.
cart.personalised_label: Personalised — we’ll print from your mockup

products.lead: Upload your photo as a JPG or PNG. We’ll mock up your design and confirm it with you before we dispatch.
products.upload_confirm: We’ll mock up your design and confirm it with you before we dispatch — we won’t print the stock product photo.
products.upload_type: Please upload a JPG or PNG.
products.file_too_large: That file is too large. Please use a photo under 15 MB.
products.file_attached: __FILENAME__ attached. We’ll mock up and confirm before dispatch.

contact.lead: Questions about an order, a print, or delivery? Use the form or the chat button — we’ll get back to you as soon as we can.
contact.aside_body: Include your order number if you have one — it helps us find your print faster.
contact.chat_note: Prefer to chat? Use the chat button in the corner of the page.
contact.name: Name
contact.success: Thanks — we’ve received your message and will get back to you.

delivery.title: Printed locally
delivery.local_print: Printed in {{ country }}. Typical delivery {{ days }}.
delivery.printed_in_eu: Printed in the EU. Typical delivery {{ days }}.
delivery.nearest_hub: Printed at the nearest Gelato hub. Typical delivery {{ days }}.
delivery.duties: Import duties may apply when an order is produced outside your country.
delivery.returns_eu: EU and UK customers have a statutory cooling-off period for unused goods. Personalised items made to order may have limited return rights — see our refund policy.
delivery.returns_generic: Personalised photo products are made to order. See our refund policy for returns and reprints.
delivery.not_all_products: Not every product is printed in every country. If a local hub cannot produce your item, Gelato ships from the nearest partner.
delivery.heading: Shipping & delivery
delivery.lead: We print on demand with Gelato. In countries with a local print hub, your order is usually produced nearby for faster delivery.
delivery.rates: Shipping is calculated at checkout for your country, based on size and destination.

chooser.fallback: Open the canvas product to choose size and personalise.
chooser.thickness_help: Slim for a modern flush look, thick for a gallery wrap.
chooser.orientation_help: Portrait, landscape, or square — all options shown.
chooser.size_hint: All matching sizes for your selection
chooser.cta_note: Next: personalise with your photo on the product page.

collection.mugs_lead: Ceramic, enamel, porcelain, magic and travel mugs — pick a style, then personalise with your photo.
collection.phone_cases_lead: Flexi, slim, clear, bio and tough cases for Apple and Samsung — pick a style and model, then personalise.
collection.totes_lead: Classic and premium personalised totes — pick a colour, then add your photo or design.
collection.wall_art_lead: Canvas, framed prints, metal, acrylic, posters and more — pick a product type to personalise.
collection.home_gifts_lead: Personalised mugs, bottles, phone cases, tote bags, stickers, tattoos and more — everyday keepsakes they’ll actually use.
collection.posters_lead: Pick a paper finish. Next you’ll choose size and personalise with your photo.
collection.framed_prints_lead: Wooden or metal frames — pick a finish, then choose size, colour and assembly where available.
collection.aluminum_lead: Sleek aluminium panels — choose a finish, then orientation and size.
collection.foam_lead: Lightweight foam board — portrait, landscape or square, with optional edge colour.

product_page.customise_body: Use Personalize design to upload your photo, preview on a live mockup, then add to cart. We print and ship to your door.
product_page.wrap_body_cm: Choose a modern slim edge (~2 cm) or a deeper gallery wrap (~4 cm) for every size.
product_page.wrap_body_in: Choose a modern slim edge (~0.8 in) or a deeper gallery wrap (~1.6 in) for every size.
product_page.sizes_body: Portrait, landscape and square options across {{ count }} sizes — pick what fits your wall.
product_page.tray_body: Wood, dark wood or black tray frames that give your canvas a clean gallery finish.
product_page.wood_frame_body: White, wood, dark wood or black wooden frames — metal framed prints coming soon as a separate range.
product_page.frame_colours_body: White, wood, dark wood or black — match your room and let the print take centre stage.
product_page.paper_body: This finish is selected on the posters page — more paper options coming soon as separate products.
product_page.personalize_hint: Use Personalize design to upload your photo and see the live mockup, then add to cart.
